title: The sum of a fixed decimal column is a fixed decimal

source.quote: corresponds to the following SUMX call
source.supports: SUM ( t[c] ) is SUMX ( t, t[c] ): a chain of additions

source.quote: Otherwise, when a currency is involved then the result is currency.

derivation: V[Amt] holds 10.5, BLANK, 0, -2.25, 10.5, 4, BLANK. 10.5 + 0 - 2.25 + 10.5 + 4 = 22.75. Currency + currency stays currency.
